name: They Call Him Smiling Jim
summary: Guard Byron sends you to Theramore for the story of They Call Him Smiling Jim. He hints that Jim's life was not always this way.

sections.title: A Sad Story
sections.body: Guard Byron remembers the fine inn Smiling Jim once kept in the marsh. He pities Jim, but would rather not speak of what changed. For the full story, ask Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.

sections.title: Vimes's Account
sections.body:
Captain Garran Vimes says the man's name was James Hyal. Hyal built an inn on the edge of the Barrens as a pleasant stop for travelers, and it prospered for a time.

Then Theramore lost its hold on the marsh roads, and ogres moved in. Hyal clung to his dream instead of seeking safety behind Theramore's walls. Fire consumed the Shady Rest Inn. The investigation has found little so far, and anyone who wants to help can search the rubble.

faq.answer: Guard Byron pities Smiling Jim and says his life was not always this way. Jim once kept a fine inn in the marsh.

faq.q: Why does Guard Byron send you to Captain Vimes?
faq.answer: Byron would rather not discuss Jim's past, so he sends you to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.

faq.q: Where do I find Captain Garran Vimes?
faq.answer: Captain Garran Vimes is in Theramore.
